title: Contact Supply Running Low
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=contacts:order supply_days=* days_since_order=* boxes_on_hand=*
| eval days_remaining=supply_days-days_since_order
| where days_remaining<=7 AND boxes_on_hand<=1
| sort days_remaining
| table lens_brand days_remaining boxes_on_hand order_status
description: Lists contact lens orders with seven or fewer supply days remaining and one or fewer boxes on hand.
value: Running out of contacts forces expensive emergency orders or wearing lenses past safe replacement dates.
implementation: Track `supply_days`, `days_since_order`, and `boxes_on_hand` and alert before the one-week window.
visualization: Table of lens brands sorted by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks contact lens orders that are about to run out before you reorder.
